hero.subtitle: Lead. Create. Celebrate.
hero.location: K L University, Vaddeswaram, Andhra Pradesh

youthChangemakerTalks.title: Youth Changemaker Talks
youthChangemakerTalks.subtitle: Focused on empowering young people to become active agents of positive change, highlighting their innovative solutions, leadership, and passion for tackling social and economic issues, moving beyond 'future leaders' to 'present-day doers'.
youthChangemakerTalks.location: K L University, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
youthChangemakerTalks.sectionSubtitle: Connect with visionary speakers, industry experts, and social entrepreneurs driving innovation and impact across the nation.

youthCon.title: Youth Con
youthCon.subtitle: Connecting the Strangers - A unique platform for meaningful conversations, networking, and mentoring between youth and industry leaders.
youthCon.location: K L University, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
youthCon.sectionSubtitle: Build relationships with industry leaders, entrepreneurs, and peers from across India.
youthCon.speedMentoringDesc: Get personalized guidance from experienced mentors in quick, focused sessions. Learn from their journeys and get actionable advice for your career.
youthCon.speedNetworkingDesc: Fast-paced networking sessions to meet fellow youth, entrepreneurs, and professionals. Expand your network and discover collaboration opportunities.
youthCon.meetupsDesc: Informal gatherings to connect with like-minded individuals, share experiences, and build lasting friendships in a relaxed environment.

youthImpactLabs.title: Youth Impact Labs
youthImpactLabs.subtitle: Hands-on workshops and innovation labs where young people collaborate to develop practical solutions for community challenges.
youthImpactLabs.location: K L University, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
youthImpactLabs.sectionSubtitle: Collaborate with changemakers and innovators to solve real-world problems through social entrepreneurship and hackathon challenges.
youthImpactLabs.hackathonDesc: A Social Hackathon is an intensive, collaborative event where young innovators come together to solve pressing social challenges through technology, creativity, and entrepreneurship.
youthImpactLabs.identifyProblemsDesc: Work on genuine social challenges facing communities in Andhra Pradesh and beyond.
youthImpactLabs.buildSolutionsDesc: Collaborate with teams to design and prototype innovative solutions in just 2 days.
youthImpactLabs.globalMentorshipDesc: Get guidance from diaspora mentors and industry experts from around the world.
youthImpactLabs.createImpactDesc: Present your solutions and get a chance to implement them with government support.
youthImpactLabs.learnByDoingDesc: Apply your skills to real problems and gain hands-on experience in solution design.
youthImpactLabs.networkGloballyDesc: Connect with the diaspora community and build relationships that transcend borders.
youthImpactLabs.winRecognitionDesc: Showcase your innovations and get recognized by government and industry leaders.

youthArtWall.title: Youth Art Wall
youthArtWall.subtitle: Your imagination, your canvas. Paint, sketch, doodle, draw or tell stories — let your art speak for your dreams, hopes, angst or joy. This isn't just a wall, it's where your voice becomes visible.
youthArtWall.location: K L University, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
youthArtWall.sectionSubtitle: Whether you're a seasoned artist or picking up a brush for the first time, the Youth Art Wall welcomes all forms of creative expression.
youthArtWall.paintingDesc: Express your vision through vibrant colors and bold strokes on the giant collaborative canvas.
youthArtWall.sketchingDesc: Quick sketches, detailed portraits, or abstract lines—every mark tells a story.
youthArtWall.doodlingDesc: Let your imagination run wild with playful doodles that bring joy and creativity.
youthArtWall.graffitiArtDesc: Street art meets festival spirit—create bold statements that capture youth energy.
youthArtWall.visualStorytellingDesc: Use art to narrate stories of hope, dreams, and the future you envision.
youthArtWall.collaborativeArtDesc: Join hands with fellow artists to create something bigger than yourself.
youthArtWall.howToParticipateSubtitle: No barriers, no rules—just pure creative freedom.
youthArtWall.showUpDesc: Visit the Youth Art Wall zone during the festival. No prior registration needed!
youthArtWall.pickYourSpotDesc: Choose an empty section of the wall or join an ongoing collaborative piece.
youthArtWall.createDesc: Express yourself freely. All art supplies are provided—just bring your creativity!
youthArtWall.signShareDesc: Sign your artwork and share it on social media with #YUVAArtWall.
youthArtWall.bePartOfDesc: The Youth Art Wall isn't just about individual pieces—it's about creating a collective masterpiece that represents the dreams and aspirations of Andhra Pradesh's youth.

talentCarnival.title: Youth Talent Carnival
talentCarnival.subtitle: Think of it as stage-time for everything you love — poetry, dance, music, stand-up, storytelling, beatboxing… basically anything that shows your creative spark. No judgement, no dynamics — just a stage waiting for your vibe.
talentCarnival.location: K L University, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
talentCarnival.sectionSubtitle: A celebration of raw talent, creativity, and the boundless energy of youth.
talentCarnival.openMicDesc: Take the spotlight and perform your heart out in front of an enthusiastic crowd. Every voice matters!
talentCarnival.liveMusicDesc: From classical to contemporary, showcase your musical talents and dance moves that set the stage on fire.
talentCarnival.poetryStorytellingDesc: Words have power. Share your stories, poems, and spoken word pieces that inspire and move audiences.
talentCarnival.standupBeatboxDesc: Make them laugh, make them groove! Comedians and beatboxers bring unique energy to the carnival.
talentCarnival.whyYoullLoveSubtitle: More than just a stage—it's where dreams take flight.
talentCarnival.zeroJudgmentDesc: A supportive environment where every performance is celebrated, regardless of experience level.
talentCarnival.connectArtistsDesc: Meet like-minded creative souls from across Andhra Pradesh and build lasting connections.
talentCarnival.recognitionPrizesDesc: Outstanding performers get recognized with awards, certificates, and exciting prizes.
talentCarnival.unforgettableExpDesc: Create memories that last a lifetime in the most energetic festival atmosphere.
talentCarnival.step1: Register online through the YUVA portal
talentCarnival.step2: Select your performance category (music, poetry, stand-up, etc.)
talentCarnival.step4: Arrive at the venue on your scheduled day

yuvasrishti.title: Yuvasrishti
yuvasrishti.subtitle: Step into the heart of Andhra's heritage — explore crafts, handlooms, local artistry and culture, led by youth for youth. Traditional skills meet youthful energy, with interactive stalls, artisans' stories and creative showcases rooted in our culture.
yuvasrishti.location: K L University, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
yuvasrishti.sectionSubtitle: A living showcase of Andhra Pradesh's rich artistic heritage and craftsmanship.
yuvasrishti.traditionalCraftsDesc: Witness master artisans at work—pottery, weaving, wood carving, and centuries-old techniques passed down through generations.
yuvasrishti.handloomHeritageDesc: Explore the rich tradition of Andhra handlooms—Mangalagiri, Uppada, Venkatagiri, and more—each thread telling a story.
yuvasrishti.artisanMarketplaceDesc: Shop directly from artisans, supporting local communities while taking home authentic pieces of Andhra's heritage.
yuvasrishti.liveDemonstrationsDesc: Watch craftspeople create magic before your eyes—from block printing to bronze casting.
yuvasrishti.connectsWithSubtitle: More than exhibits—meaningful connections with the people and stories behind the craft.
yuvasrishti.masterArtisansDesc: Meet the guardians of traditional crafts and learn their stories of preserving heritage.
yuvasrishti.youngEntrepreneursDesc: Connect with youth who are reviving traditional crafts with modern business approaches.
yuvasrishti.sustainablePracticesDesc: Discover eco-friendly craft techniques that honor both tradition and the environment.
yuvasrishti.culturalStoriesDesc: Every craft has a story—learn about the history, symbolism, and meaning behind each creation.
yuvasrishti.heritageWalkDesc: Guided tours through craft villages and artisan communities
yuvasrishti.handsOnWorkshopDesc: Try your hand at traditional crafts with expert guidance
yuvasrishti.artisanStoriesDesc: Interactive sessions with master craftspeople sharing their journeys
yuvasrishti.youthInnovationHubDesc: Where traditional crafts meet modern design and technology

carnivalParade.title: Carnival Parade
carnivalParade.subtitle: A vibrant street parade featuring floats, performers, and cultural displays from all districts of Andhra Pradesh.
carnivalParade.location: K L University, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh

andhraYuvaSankalp.subtitle: A digital marathon on the themes of Youth Empowerment, AI, Fitness & Social Impact. Unleashing the talent and creativity of youth through content creation for social awareness.
andhraYuvaSankalp.location: K L University, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh

registration.title: Register for YUVA 2025
registration.subtitle: Join thousands of youth from across Andhra Pradesh. Be part of Swarnandhra's future.
registration.cardTitle: Ready to be part of YUVA 2025?
registration.cardDescription: Fill out our registration form to secure your spot at the Andhra Pradesh State Youth Festival. Choose your preferred events and connect with youth leaders across the state.
registration.note: Registration is free and open to all youth from Andhra Pradesh

joinUs.heroButton: Be Part of the Organising Team
joinUs.title: Join the YUVA Organising Team
joinUs.subtitle: Apply to contribute behind the scenes as a reporter, fellow, or creator and help shape the Andhra Pradesh State Youth Festival.
joinUs.chooseRoleDesc: We're looking for passionate young people to join our team in four exciting roles.

reporters.title: YUVA Reporters
reporters.tagline: Be the voice of the festival
reporters.intro: YUVA Reporters are the storytellers of the festival, capturing moments, interviewing participants, and sharing the energy of YUVA 2025 with the world. You'll work closely with the media team to create compelling content that showcases youth talent and festival highlights.

fellows.title: Yuvasrishti Fellows
fellows.tagline: Shape the future of youth policy
fellows.intro: Yuvasrishti Fellows are emerging leaders who contribute to policy discussions, youth development initiatives, and community engagement. This fellowship offers a unique opportunity to work alongside government officials and policy experts to shape programs that impact millions of young people in Andhra Pradesh.

creators.title: YUVA Creators Squad
creators.intro: The YUVA Creators Squad is a team of digital content creators who bring the festival to life online. From Instagram reels to YouTube vlogs, from graphic design to photography, creators will produce engaging content that captures the spirit of YUVA 2025 and reaches millions across social media.

organisers.title: YUVA Organisers
organisers.intro: The Andhra Pradesh State Youth Festival (YUVA 2025) invites dynamic youth to join the Organising Team, the group that works closely with the management team to run the festival smoothly and professionally. This is the perfect opportunity for students who want real event experience, enjoy teamwork, love leadership roles, and want to be part of a state-level movement.

joinUs.dontMissOpportunity: Don't miss this opportunity to be part of the largest youth festival in Andhra Pradesh. Applications are open for a limited time.
